I just realized the theme holds types of music of each age.
Simple flutes for the Cavemen period, 
String instruments like the violin for late-Medieval/Renaissance period, 
Drum-march for post WWII military, 
And fluctuating, electronic keyboard beats for space-tech age.
Proof that music is eternal.
